Cheese Bannock (Quick fried bread recipe)
By: A Kitchen Advisor
Published: Wednesday, July 1, 2020 - 11:44am

Ingredients




Dough:
Buttermilk 3.25% fat 1 cup
Baking Soda 1/3 tsp
Salt 1/2 tsp
Sugar 1/2 tsp
Vegetable oil 2 tbsp
Egg 1
Flour 2 1/2 - 3 cups
Filling:
Mozzarella cheese 10 ounce
Mixed herbs green onion (1/2 cup), dill (1/2 cup) and cilantro (1/2 cup)
Egg 1
Salt and pepper to taste
Buttering:
Melted Butter 2 tbsp

Preparation

1 Let's start making Cheese Bannocks by pouring Buttermilk into a large bowl. 2 Add Baking Soda and mix it. 3 Season with salt and pepper, add 1 egg and whisk it well. 4 Pour vegetable oil, we used sunflower oil. 5 Sieve the flour and add half of it into the bowl, mix it. Similarly, add another half of the sieved flour. 6 Make a soft dough. 7 Turn dough out on a lightly floured surface, and knead gently. 8 Form a ball, and divide it into 4 equal parts. 9 Cover it with plastic wrap and set aside to rest. 10 Let's make the filling. 11 Grate Mozzarella cheese. 12 Mix it with 1 egg, add freshly chopped green onion, dill, cilantro and salt and pepper to your taste. 13 Mix it well. 14 Roll bannocks. 15 Divide filling into 4 parts and add it into each dough piece. 16 Wrap the filling. 17 Gently press it to form perfectly flat bannock. 18 Fry it one by one on a dry frying pan. fry it on a medium heat 1.5- 2 minutes on each side. 19 Cover the Frying Pan with the lid to make it rise. 20 Once the bannock turns golden brown, flip it on another side. 21 Brush bannocks with melted butter to make them softer. 22 Finally, make a pile by putting them one on top of another.

Certainly, everybody loves easy, quick and delicious recipes.  In other words, these kind of recipes are in high demand at the times when you run out of all your products and there only basic ingredients left in your fridge. Above all, today we will share with you one of the recipes which is not only quick, easy and yummy but also healthy as it is fried WITHOUT any oil. Most importantly, here comes a Cheese Bannock (Quick fried bread recipe) made with buttermilk.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=44drnm4_Nds
Equipment

12” Stir Deep Fry Pan

Portable Induction Cooktop


As always, there are some useful tips that might help you achieve the best results.
Firstly, use homemade Buttermilk.
Secondly, do not use any oil to fry quick Bannocks.
As always, we share with you only the recipes that we made many times and selected as per the strict criteria for busy families that care about the budget and health.
